description: Asia's cruise-first online travel platform, based in New Delhi, India, offering cruise vacations across 25+ international cruise lines and 300+ destinations. Its Creator Hub is an affiliate program built exclusively for travel and cruise content creators: 5% commission on the total cruise fare for every confirmed booking, a live earnings dashboard, and explicit no-cap earnings statements on the brand's own program page — a verified-uncapped program.

evidence.summary: The brand's own Creator Hub page states 'No cap. No ceiling.' for commission on every booking, and its FAQ section states 'There is no limit to how much you can earn' — an explicit no-cap earnings statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is uncapped.

Program mechanics from the same page: 'You earn 5% commission on the fare — tracked live, paid transparently'; free to join with no registration fees; applications reviewed within 2–3 business days; no minimum follower count — 'Int2Cruises focuses on content quality and audience engagement rather than follower count alone'; commissions paid via direct bank transfer after a confirmed booking; queries to marketing@int2cruises.com. Top performers can unlock free cruise (barter) collaborations.

name: Int2Cruises

reasons.compensation: 5% of the total cruise fare with an explicit 'No cap. No ceiling.' statement — verified-uncapped; cruise fares are high-value, so per-booking commissions run from tens to hundreds of dollars, though the percentage itself is modest.
reasons.contact_access: A published program email (marketing@int2cruises.com) and phone number appear directly on the Creator Hub page.
reasons.credibility: A young, India-based cruise platform rather than an established global OTA; terms are clearly published, but the brand is little-known outside its home market.
reasons.niche_fit: Cruise vacations are a growing travel-creator niche — ship tours, itinerary vlogs and booking tips — though narrower than general travel gear.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join, no minimum follower count, applications reviewed within 2–3 business days.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-only program by design: the page addresses social media creators, travel bloggers, podcasters and community hosts by name, with a personalised link and promo code issued on approval.

evidence.summary: The brand's own partner FAQ: 'The VisitorsCoverage Partner Program allows you to earn referral fees when your client purchases an insurance policy through your unique link, banner or widget... Referral fees are based on the price of the policy sold... Partners who apply through our online form will be eligible to reach an Elite Partner level which allows for higher fees.' Joining is free, no licence is required, the program is available worldwide, and partners are paid monthly once the balance reaches $100. The brand publishes no percentage and no earnings-cap statement, so commission_rate is null and commission_cap is unknown.

Travelpayouts' program page documents the flat fee table: policy $10–$49.99 pays $1; $50–$199.99 pays $5; $200–$599.99 pays $20; $600–$1,999.99 pays $60; $2,000+ pays $100, with a 30-day cookie — flat per-sale referral fees (described as up to ~10% of policy price), not a percentage rate.
